verdicts.reason: A shrinks the can to a tiny icon at the bottom, which loses the key product image. It puts the CTA top-right ahead of the headline, so the reading order is wrong. It reorders the flavour list (Mango and Cola before Grape and Lime) and leaves wide empty side margins around a narrow centred column. B uses a sensible banner layout: a large can on the left, then headline, list and a prominent CTA on the right. But the FIZZBANG! logo is shrunk to a near-illegible badge stranded in the bottom-left corner, the list has the same reordering, and the text column is cramped against the right edge.
